items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1961-04-07
items.q: Like Franky Dusen, he could make good parts from ones and he couldn't read nothing harder.

ctx.x: Isn't that the hardest thing to do? Because the trumpet man, all he has to do is take a melody line. Anybody can do that.
But you know those trombone players. Like Franky Dusen, he could make good parts from ones and he couldn't read nothing harder. But he could make good parts.
